availability.same_timestamp_rule: context streams expose events with ts_init < T only

outcome.strict_gap_rule: max_gap must be shorter than the horizon under strict, else a horizon with zero interior observations expires instead of censoring GAP

qualify.text: excursion.frozen_atr > 0 and regime_1m.age_s >= 120s and excursion.mfe_atr >= 1.0 and excursion.progress_windows >= 2 and excursion.retained_ratio >= 0.5 and features.structural_snapshot_ready

study.description: Cross-instrument portability. Fixed architecture, fixed 13-feature surface, fixed direction-specific hyperparameters carried over from the NQ parent; only the instrument and the fitting rows change. No feature discovery, no tuning, no economics.
study.question: Does the frozen NQ 13-feature 180s Model C architecture, trained natively on ES 2020-2023, show meaningful forward discrimination for a prevailing 1m regime flip within 180s on untouched ES 2024?
